title: Mark hebrew-terms.md §11 item 5 as fixed — the make audit grep already targets the right symbol

evidence.quote: The `make audit` layering grep targets a symbol name (`hebrewTermsScriptProvider`) that does not exist...
echo "7/15 — No useHebrewTermsProvider read outside core/labels..."; \

why: learning_tracker/Makefile check 7 already greps for `useHebrewTermsProvider` (the real provider name), not `hebrewTermsScriptProvider` — which has zero occurrences anywhere in the repo. Every sibling item in this same numbered list (3, 4, 6, 7, 8) that got fixed carries a '— FIXED (A4)' annotation; item 5 is missing one, so the doc still presents a working control as broken. A reader could waste time re-"fixing" a grep that already works, or distrust a control that is functioning.
recommendation: Add '— FIXED' to hebrew-terms.md §11 item 5, or remove it if the underlying grep-correction was folded into an earlier commit.
acceptance_criteria: hebrew-terms.md §11 item 5 either is removed or carries a FIXED annotation consistent with its siblings
